source_location.excerpt: Sample 2: Industry-Specific Compliance Annexure – Annexure B

clauses.text: 1. Purpose and Scope

source_location.excerpt: 1. Purpose and Scope

clauses.text: This Annexure (“Annexure B”) forms an integral part of the Master Services Agreement (“MSA”) executed between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions (“Vendor”) and FinSecure Services (“Client”) dated [Insert Date]. The purpose of this Annexure is to establish comprehensive guidelines for regulatory compliance, operational governance, and IT security specifically related to electronic hardware solutions deployed in the BFSI environment. The scope encompasses the full lifecycle of all hardware provided under the MSA, including procurement, installation, operation, maintenance, upgrade, decommissioning, and disposal, in accordance with the relevant Indian laws, RBI guidelines, IT Act 2000, and industry best practices. This Annexure ensures that both Vendor and Client undertake shared responsibility for operational resilience, security compliance, and risk management in a mutually accountable framework.

clauses.text: 2. Regulatory and Industry Compliance Requirements

source_location.excerpt: 2. Regulatory and Industry Compliance Requirements

clauses.text:
a. RBI and SEBI Guidelines:
The parties acknowledge the mandatory compliance requirements issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and, where applicable, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for IT infrastructure and vendor management. The Vendor shall ensure that all hardware meets regulatory standards for operational continuity, business resilience, data security, and reporting. The Client shall provide timely updates regarding changes to guidelines affecting hardware operations.

source_location.excerpt:
a. RBI and SEBI Guidelines:
The parties acknowledge the mandatory compliance requirements issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and, where applicable, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) for IT infrastructure and vendor management. The Vendor shall ensure that all hardware meets regulatory standards for operational continuity, business resilience, data security, and reporting. The Client shall provide timely updates regarding changes to guidelines affecting hardware operations.

clauses.text:
b. Data Protection and IT Security Compliance:
Both parties shall comply with the Information Technology Act, 2000, and any applicable rules under the IT (Reasonable Security Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011. All hardware systems shall incorporate secure data storage, encryption of sensitive customer data, and access control mechanisms. Any breach of security or unauthorized access must be reported immediately to both parties and, if required, to the regulatory authorities within prescribed timelines.

c. Industry Standards Compliance:
The Vendor shall ensure compliance with globally recognized standards such as ISO/IEC 27001 (Information Security Management Systems), ISO/IEC 20000 (IT Service Management), and relevant ITIL practices. The Client shall have the right to verify compliance through evidence such as certification reports, internal audits, or third-party audits.

clauses.text: 3. Hardware Lifecycle Management

source_location.excerpt: 3. Hardware Lifecycle Management

clauses.text:
a. Procurement and Quality Assurance:
The Vendor shall procure hardware components that are certified, compliant with Indian regulatory and industry standards, and free from malicious software. Quality assurance processes shall include thorough inspection, testing, and verification of compliance before delivery.

source_location.excerpt:
a. Procurement and Quality Assurance:
The Vendor shall procure hardware components that are certified, compliant with Indian regulatory and industry standards, and free from malicious software. Quality assurance processes shall include thorough inspection, testing, and verification of compliance before delivery.

clauses.text:
b. Installation and Configuration:
All hardware shall be installed according to mutually agreed standard operating procedures (SOPs) ensuring secure network configuration, physical security, and operational readiness. Change management procedures shall be documented, including configuration records and approvals from both parties.

source_location.excerpt:
b. Installation and Configuration:
All hardware shall be installed according to mutually agreed standard operating procedures (SOPs) ensuring secure network configuration, physical security, and operational readiness. Change management procedures shall be documented, including configuration records and approvals from both parties.

clauses.text:
c. Maintenance and Updates:
The Vendor shall provide timely updates, patches, and preventive maintenance services to ensure the hardware remains compliant and secure. Any updates or configuration changes must be communicated to the Client in advance, and rollback procedures must be established in case of operational disruptions.

source_location.excerpt:

d. Decommissioning and Disposal:
At the end of the hardware lifecycle, the Vendor shall ensure secure decommissioning and disposal of all equipment in accordance with environmental and data privacy regulations. All sensitive data must be securely erased, and certificates of destruction shall be provided to the Client.

clauses.text: 4. Incident Management and Reporting

source_location.excerpt: 4. Incident Management and Reporting

clauses.text: Both parties shall maintain a documented incident management process, covering hardware failure, security breaches, and regulatory non-compliance events.

clauses.text: Incidents must be reported to the designated points of contact of both parties within mutually agreed timelines. Critical incidents affecting operations or regulatory compliance must be escalated immediately.

source_location.excerpt: 5. Audit, Monitoring, and Compliance Verification

clauses.text: The Client reserves the right to conduct periodic audits to verify Vendor compliance with this Annexure. Audits may include physical inspection, review of maintenance logs, vulnerability assessment reports, and testing of hardware security controls.

clauses.text: 7. Confidentiality and Information Security

source_location.excerpt: 7. Confidentiality and Information Security

clauses.text: Both parties recognize that hardware systems may process sensitive financial information and personal data. Each party shall implement controls to prevent unauthorized access, leakage, or misuse of such data. Any engagement of third-party support services must comply with the same confidentiality, security, and compliance standards. Breach of confidentiality or improper handling of sensitive data constitutes a material breach of this Annexure.

clauses.text: 9. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

source_location.excerpt: 9. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

clauses.text: This Annexure shall be governed by the laws of India. Any disputes arising in connection with this Annexure shall be resolved amicably through mutual discussion. Failing resolution, disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of courts in [City, State].
